emails.subject: Bench Notes idea: pitch drift
emails.content:
Hi Kofi! Big fan of the Bench Notes posts. Any chance you'd do one on pitch drift? My turntable speeds up and slows down over a side and I can't tell if it's the belt or something else. Happy to send a video if that helps.

emails.subject: Re: Bench Notes idea: pitch drift
emails.content:
Thanks, good one. If yours has fine-speed knobs, spray contact cleaner into the speed pots and work them end to end a dozen times. If it still wanders after that, it's usually a stretched belt. Check it against a strobe disc either way so you're not guessing.

I'll add pitch drift to the Bench Notes list.

- Kofi, Corktown Audio Works

emails.subject: Re: Bench Notes idea: pitch drift
emails.content:

Nina

emails.subject: Re: Bench Notes idea: pitch drift
emails.content:
Glad it helped. If it still wanders, try a new belt before anything else. It's the cheap fix and usually the right one.
- Kofi
